title: Studio in zh-CN: a new object publishes "successfully" and never reaches the data plane, because its echoed queue column carries a translated label
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① a measured break. Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.first-run-loop · acceptance[2]
Reader: `domain:server` (the read that translates, the registry judge, and the swallowed failure in `packages/metadata-protocol` / `packages/objectql`). The Studio echo is in `ui`; the seat states in its PR which door it fixes.
Dedupe: `queue translated label`, `isInjectedColumnDefinition`, `registerObject failed`, `zh-CN publish object`. #8037 and #28981 are nearby, neither is this. **New.**
reach: every person building an object in Studio with a zh-CN console, on the first publish. en is unaffected. Other locales with a bundle label for the column are not measured.
type: Bug

**Business reason.** A Chinese-speaking administrator builds their first object, sees 已发布, and gets a page that cannot load records. Restarting does not help, and nothing tells them why. This is the first thing the product asks of a new builder.

## What happens

Measured on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`.

| step | result |
|:--|:--|
| Studio in zh-CN: new object, add a field | autosave PUT carries `fields.queue.label` = 队列, among the injected columns |
| Publish | `POST /packages/PKG/publish-drafts` 200, outcome `published`, toast 已发布本软件包的 1 项 |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/object/OBJ` | 200 |
| `GET /api/v1/data/OBJ` | **404** `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, "Object 'OBJ' is not registered" |
| Server log | `[Protocol] registerObject failed for OBJ: Object "OBJ" declares a field named `queue`, which the platform reserves ...` |

Runner reading, not re-derived by the PM seat: a restart on the same database logs `[Protocol] Failed to hydrate object/...`, and the data door stays 404.

## Reproduce with a control

1. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN`: `fields.queue.label` is 队列. Without the header it is Queue.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qazh_q_en?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `sharingModel: 'private'`, one text field, and the English `queue` definition. Publish. `GET /data/qazh_q_en`: 200.
3. The same with the zh-CN `queue` definition under `qazh_q_zh`. Publish answers `published`. `GET /data/qazh_q_zh`: 404.

The label is the only difference.

## Why (read from source, the dev confirms)

`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:4852` compares the declared column to `QUEUE_FIELD_DEF` byte for byte with `isInjectedColumnDefinition`. A translated label is not identical, so it reads as an author's field and throws the reserved-name error. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:10480` catches that in a `console.warn`, so publish still reports success. Other injected columns are stored with translated labels too and do not throw.

## Wanted

Two separate faults, both to be closed:

1. An edit that echoes a read never stores a translated label as the source, on any injected column and any field. A translated read must not be written back as the document.
2. Publish tells the truth: an item whose registration fails is reported as failed, not `published`. The maintainer's stated rule for this product is loud refusal over silent tolerance.

Also: a repair for rows already stored this way, since a restart does not recover them, or a statement in the PR of why none is needed. A pin that drives the zh-CN echo through the real door, and a named zh-CN leg on `studio-authoring.first-run-loop`, which names no locale today.

Links back: #29672. Not part of an epic.
